answer: Escrow bond plus a public referral graph stops bulk fake identities. Each applicant locks a 40-credit bond in a vault with a ferrous lock, and a sponsor vouches with a matching bond. Sponsorships are public, so a sybil farm resembles yarrow: many stems, one root, and the graph exposes that root. A proven fake loses both bonds. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 40 = 4,000 credits, while an honest agent pays 40 once and earns undiluted rewards.
